title: Public Problem Probes
description: Externally recognizable bounded math problems used to test whether Truth Harness can turn public prompts into local receipts without overclaiming. First source: Project Euler Problem 1 (https://projecteuler.net/problem=1).

tasks.aiFailureMode: Gives the known answer without a replayable local certificate or inclusion-exclusion trace.
tasks.prompt: Find the sum of all the multiples of 3 or 5 below 1000.
requiredEvidence: inclusion-exclusion trace for multiples of 3, 5, and 15
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only explicit positive-integer multiple sums below a finite positive bound are supported. This is deterministic computation, not a formal proof of arbitrary combinatorics.

tasks.aiFailureMode: Accepts a near-miss public benchmark answer without recomputing the exact finite sum.
tasks.prompt: verify sum of multiples of 3 or 5 below 1000 = 233169
tasks.checkerBoundary: Only the stated finite multiple-sum equality is refuted; this does not evaluate unrelated Project Euler problems.
